hints.title: Arbitrary Initial Rooting
hints.text: Root the tree arbitrarily at node 0 and count how many guesses are satisfied in that initial rooted configuration.

hints.title: Adjacent Root Transition
hints.text: When moving the root from node u to an adjacent node v, the only directed edge that changes direction is the edge between u and v.

hints.title: Local Delta Adjustment
hints.text: Subtract 1 if (u, v) was among the guesses, and add 1 if (v, u) is among the guesses. Propagate this change to all roots.

hints.title: Rerooting Tree DFS Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Two DFS passes over tree edges and O(1) hash set lookups for guesses.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a full traversal from every node takes O(n * (n + g)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + g) adjacency list and guess set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard rerooting dynamic programming across tree edges.
